description: List all live streams. Returns array of {id, title, status, scheduled_at, region, quality_package, save_vod, stream_key_id, stream_key, rtmp, live_player, created_at}. Status: provisioning (channel starting), offline (waiting for signal or scheduled), online, finishing, finished, finished_imported (recording became a video), expired (no signal in time; can be regenerated). stream_key is a secret credential: show it only when the user asks for it (e.g. to set up OBS).
name: panda_list_lives
title: List Lives
